Subject: Request: short IAM questionnaire + SCIM mappings for RFP

Neha,

Thanks for the intro last week. As part of our RFP for a federated access and provisioning solution we need a concise capability matrix and a couple of SCIM mapping examples to include in the package to our procurement team. Can you confirm the following and attach any supporting docs?

- Do you support SAML 2.0 and OIDC (both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows)? Any nuances we should be aware of for multi-tenant SSO?
- SCIM: Do you implement SCIM 2.0? Are PATCH and bulk operations supported? Do you support group push and nested-group handling?
- RBAC / admin controls: can roles be customized per-tenant, are there delegated admin roles, and what audit logging is available?
- Certificate rotation process for SAML metadata and recommended TTLs?
- Any rate limits on SCIM provisioning or recommended windowing for large orgs?

RFP deadline is May 1st — if you can send a short PDF of answers and a SCIM attribute mapping we can slot it straight into the RFP binder. Also, if you have a sample SCIM PATCH payload it would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Sam

Sam — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a concise packet that addresses each item (PDF) and a SCIM schema mapping JSON with the most common attribute/role examples. High level answers below; the PDF has expanded notes and enterprise deployment options.

- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) for both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We support standard metadata exchange, automatic metadata refresh (optional), and IdP-initiated sign-on. For multi-tenant customers we recommend one SP per tenant when tenant isolation is required; otherwise a shared SP with tenant-scoped assertions is supported.

- SCIM: We implement SCIM 2.0 (RFC7644) with support for PATCH (RFC7644 patch), bulk operations (RFC7643 bulk), group push, and delta sync. We also support schema extensions for tenant-specific attributes and can accept custom attributes under x-extensions. Rate limits are configurable on Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted defaults are documented in the attached PDF.

- RBAC & admin controls: Roles are configurable per-account. Default admin/owner roles are provided; customers can create custom roles and map SCIM groups to RBAC roles. Delegated admin scopes are available (e.g., user_admin, group_admin, billing_admin). All admin actions are audited — audit logs include actor, timestamp, action type, and object ID. Logs are available via the Console and exportable to your SIEM via secure syslog or S3 export.

- Certificate rotation: We support certificate rotation via metadata updates and an automated rotation API. Recommended TTL for SAML signing certs is 12 months; for customers with stricter controls we support 90-day rotation workflows and can automate rollover windows with a staged key rollout.

- Large orgs / rate limits: For SCIM provisioning we recommend batching large imports (we provide a bulk import endpoint). Hosted customers have a base SCIM rate limit (documented) and we will profile and raise limits for Dedicated customers.

Attachments included: Redwood_SAML_SCIM_RBAC_Answers_20260421.pdf, SCIM-schema-mapping.json

If it helps, Marissa (cc'd) can follow up with concrete SCIM PATCH examples and our cert-rotation playbook. Are you available for a 30-min walkthrough Thursday Apr 22, 10:00am PT?

Regards,

- SCIM PATCH: can you share an example PATCH payload for an update that maps an AD group to a Redwood role (and how you handle role removals)?
- Cert rotation: if we do a staged rollover (old/new overlap), will SP metadata accept both keys during the transition window?

If possible, please send sample payloads and the certificate rotation notes. I attached our provisioning requirements doc for reference (epsilon-specific-provisioning-reqs.docx). Technical contact for our infra team is Aisha (cc).

Subject: SCIM PATCH examples + cert rotation playbook (Epsilon RFP)

Hi Sam/Aisha — looping in Rishi from our Applied ML/Infra group for anything deeper. Per Neha's packet, I attached a short set of SCIM PATCH examples that show: add group -> role mapping, remove user from role, and nested-group expansion. We perform recursive expansion server-side by default for Hosted and Dedicated customers; for very large nested trees we can accept pre-flattened membership to reduce sync time — both patterns are supported.

Key items attached: scim-patch-examples.txt (three payloads), cert-rotation-playbook.pdf (staged rollover steps and recommended TTLs), signed-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (if you want to move forward with the procurement team we'll sign and return the MAP).

A few operational notes:
- PATCH semantics: we honor standard op:add/op:remove on groups and maintain an operation log for conflict resolution.
- Role mapping: SCIM group "enterprise-admins" -> Redwood role "admin:tenant" is a typical example (see sample).
- Overlap during cert rollover: SP metadata will accept the new key once uploaded; during the staged window we accept both keys provided the rotation API is used to register the upcoming key. We recommend a 7 day overlap window for minimal disruption and automated health checks during the window.

If you'd like a quick technical working session we can schedule Rishi and I for 30-45 minutes to walk the infra team through the sample payloads and a demo. When is good for you?

Best,
